title: A mobile game that pays ZNN for daily play
body:
A match-three game with a daily ZNN reward, to bring people to the network who have never heard of it. Art and server by the proposer.

Offered: 20,000 ZNN

title: An explorer that checks what it shows
body:
Every explorer today repeats what one node told it. Build one that asks three Sentinels, verifies their answers in the browser, and says so when they disagree.

Offered: 5,000 ZNN

title: Hardware signing for Ledger and Trezor
body:
Nobody holding more than pocket money should have to keep a Zenon key on a laptop. An app for Ledger first, with no blind signing, then Trezor.

Offered: 0.8 ETH and 4,000 ZNN
